sources_audited.source_name: NESAC Seasonal Landslide Inventory for NER (annual technical reports)
sources_audited.organization: North Eastern Space Applications Centre (NESAC), NER-DRR programme
sources_audited.dataset_product_name: e.g. 'Seasonal landslide inventory for the North Eastern Region (NER) - 2023', Document No. NESAC-SR-304-2023; also NER-2021 (NESAC-SR-277-2022), NER-2025, and others
sources_audited.geographic_coverage: NER-specific (all 8 states, by design of the programme)
sources_audited.date_range: At least 2021-2025 confirmed to exist as separate annual reports (multiple distinct document numbers cited in real research)
sources_audited.has_actual_dates_per_record: Likely yes at a per-event level (the 2025 report is confirmed to include 24h pre-event rainfall per event, which requires a date) - not independently confirmed for every year's report
sources_audited.coordinates_available: Not confirmed - reports describe 'location' narratively in cited excerpts; precise coordinate fields not confirmed
sources_audited.record_count: 374 for 2025 alone (confirmed); other years' counts not confirmed
sources_audited.verification_method_for_robots_block: Direct web_fetch attempt in this session returned ROBOTS_DISALLOWED - 'Site disallows automated access' - a genuine, checkable restriction (robots.txt), not a guess or a transient failure
sources_audited.registration_required: Not confirmed to require registration for a human visiting the site directly in a browser - the block observed is specifically against automated/bot access
sources_audited.file_format: PDF technical report (confirmed by document-number citation format in peer-reviewed literature); whether a machine-readable table/shapefile companion exists was not confirmed
sources_audited.license_restrictions: Not confirmed - government technical report, likely citable with attribution per standard practice, not independently verified
sources_audited.realistic_for_ml_training: YES, but only after manual PDF acquisition and manual/semi-automated table extraction - confirmed genuinely used this way by real peer-reviewed research (Badavath, Kumar & Sahoo 2025, Landslides journal, cited this exact NESAC-SR-304-2023 report as their data source)
exact_steps_required: 1. Open https://www.nerdrr.gov.in in a standard web browser (not an automated tool - this was specifically what was blocked)
2. Locate the Seasonal Landslide Inventory for NER reports (multiple years confirmed to exist: 2021, 2023, 2025 at minimum)
4. Manually inspect whether the PDF contains a structured per-event table (date, location, coordinates if any, rainfall) or only narrative/summary text
5. Report back the actual PDF structure so a table-extraction approach (manual transcription or PDF-table-extraction tooling) can be planned in a follow-up phase

final_decision.C_strongest_candidate: NESAC Seasonal Landslide Inventory for NER (annual technical reports, e.g. NESAC-SR-304-2023)
final_decision.C_reasoning: NER-specific by design, confirmed real with specific document numbers, actively cited as a genuine data source in peer-reviewed research, already pairs events with pre-event GPM rainfall. The only barrier is that automated access is blocked (robots.txt, directly verified) - a human can access it directly, and real researchers have already successfully used it this way.
final_decision.C_exact_manual_access_required: A human must visit https://www.nerdrr.gov.in directly in a browser, locate and download the available annual Seasonal Landslide Inventory PDF reports, and report back their actual internal structure (table vs. narrative, coordinate precision).
final_decision.D_next_concrete_action: Manually download the NESAC NER seasonal inventory reports (2021, 2023, 2025 confirmed to exist - check for others) from nerdrr.gov.in or nesac.gov.in in a standard browser, and share what their actual content/structure looks like. This determines whether Phase 6D can build a PDF-table-extraction script or whether further manual transcription is needed.
